transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work. I've gotten so slowed down lately. I can just... sit there, staring at one audit workpaper for twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type anything. People have started noticing I'm not keeping up. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Um... yeah, I suppose. It's just... most days, I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It kind of feels like the day is already lost before I've even gotten out of bed. So... yeah.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Um... not really. I used to do things. Like... plan hikes, or take photos. I'd cook on Sundays... volunteer at the library. But... I don't know. Now it all just feels like... like items on a checklist. I just don't care enough to even start them. So... no.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... a while, I guess. Maybe... seven months? It started around the time my husband lost his job... when his company downsized. So... yeah, about that long.
Do you still enjoy the things you used to, even if you're not doing them as often?
Um... no. I just... I don't really get anything out of them anymore. Even if I think about doing them... it just feels pointless.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried lately?
Um... not really. I mean, I guess I worry about things sometimes, but... no more than usual, I think. I just... I don't know. It's more just feeling... empty, rather than anxious.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?

Um... yeah, I guess so. My work skirts... they've gotten pretty loose lately. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything. I just... eating feels like a chore now. I only really eat because I know I have to, so I just sort of... force it down.
Have you been feeling restless or having trouble sitting still, or is it more that you're moving and reacting slower than you used to?

Um... slower, I guess. I just... I'll sit there staring at one audit workpaper for... maybe twenty minutes... before I even move my hand to type. It's... people at work have started noticing I'm not keeping up. So... yeah. Just really slowed down.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think about that.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience any pleasure at all, even if it's just for a moment?

Um... yeah, I guess. Nothing really... feels good anymore. I used to do things. Like... plan hikes, take photos... I'd cook on Sundays, volunteer at the library. But now... I don't know. They just feel like items on a checklist. I just... I don't care enough to even start them.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to in general, not just when working?
Um... yeah. I mean, like I said about the workpapers... that's really what brought me in, because people noticed I'm not keeping up. But... yeah. It's just... everything, I guess. I'm just... slow.
Have you ever had thoughts that you would be better off dead?
Um... no. I haven't... I don't think like that. I just... no.
Do you feel like you're unable to function in your daily life most of the time?

I guess so. Um... at work, I've missed some review deadlines. I've had to hand off parts of the audits I usually manage myself. And... at home, my husband has taken over the bills and the insurance forms. I just... I can't reliably get through them right now. So... yeah.
Do you feel like your depression is interfering with your relationships with friends and family?
Um... I don't know. I guess... I just don't see people as much right now. It's... fine, I suppose.
Do you feel like there are any days where you feel somewhat better than others?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed. They mostly just... feel the same, I guess.
Do you feel like your depression has been consistently worse over the past two weeks?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't been keeping track of the weeks, honestly. It just... it all kind of blurs together at this point.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt nearly back to your normal self?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really felt like myself in... a while. So, no.
Do you feel like you've had any significant improvement in your mood or functioning at any point over the past seven months?
Not really. I mean... I can't think of a time where things felt easier. It's just... been a long time of this, I guess.
Do you feel like you're able to experience any improvement in your mood in response to positive events or activities?
I haven't really noticed. Um... there haven't exactly been any positive things lately, so... I don't know. It's hard to say.
Have you had any periods in the last seven months where your depression symptoms were significantly worse than they are now?
No... I don't think so. It all just kind of... blends together at this point. So, no, not really.
